Project Description:
The By-Pass Road on Mansa Devi Hill is inherently susceptible to slope instability due to its geomorphological and geological setting within the lower Himalayan region. The presence of steep to very steep hill slopes, fragile lithologies (weathered rock overlain by loose soil–boulder overburden), soft sandstone rock, and intense monsoon rainfall collectively create highly adverse conditions for long-term slope stability.The tectonically active nature of the region and its location in Seismic Zone VI as per new seismic code IS:1893-2025 further add to the background hazard. Field mapping along this road identified several landslide sites, representing a spectrum of instability conditions. In view of the complex ground conditions and the strategic importance of By-Pass road onMansa Devi hill, detailed slope stability analysis is essential for the design and implementation
of appropriate slope protection and stabilization measures.
Project Name: Proposal for Slope protection work of Hill Bypass road in Mansa Devi Hill, Haridwar, Uttarakhand.
